topic: Comparing Jetson and i7 performance for lidar processing
summary_markdown:
The conversation compares the performance of a Jetson device against an i7 computer when processing lidar data, specifically focusing on object extraction and tracking. Initial debug logs show that Object extractor times are significantly higher on the i7 (e.g., 157ms) compared to the Jetson (e.g., 11-22ms). 

[p1] notes that the Jetson's speed is comparable to an older i7, and debug mode performance matches release mode performance on ARM architecture. A file generated in debug mode for ARM is twice as large as the one for x86.

Discussion points include potential gains from parallelism (suggesting a comparison between 4-8 cores on i7 vs. 2048/512 available resources) and whether the code utilizes the GPU, which has not yet been tested. The current setup uses two worker threads: one for data reception and one for processing.
decisions: The team will test GPU performance using the Jetson device.
action_items: Test GPU performance on the Jetson device.
